name: Haunted Mansion Escape–Horror
storyline:

Ghost Survival Horror – Outrun creepy spirits in haunted corridors.
Mansion Survival Escape – Explore eerie rooms full of secrets.
🧩 Mystery Puzzle Games – Collect golden keys & solve scary riddles.
Horror Adventure Gameplay – A mix of Psychological Horror Games & survival.
New Haunted Game – Regular updates with new levels & scarier enemies.
Alex, a teenager, is trapped in Annie’s Haunted Mansion after a wrong turn. To survive this Scary Mansion Survival Horror nightmare, he must face ghosts, solve Mystery Puzzle Games, and collect golden keys. Every shadow hides danger – will you survive this Psychological Horror Game or be trapped forever?
Are you ready to survive the ultimate Survival Horror Game? Download Alex: Haunted Mansion Escape now – one of the scariest New Horror Games for Android. Outsmart ghosts, solve puzzles, and escape before it’s too late!"
